_readme.what: Hand-maintained corrections layered on top of the generated DeviceTemplates.json.
_readme.why: DeviceTemplates.json is extracted from the vendor app and must be regenerated rather than edited, so anything learned from real hardware that the vendor config does not describe lives here and survives the next regeneration.
_readme.merge: A section whose id matches one in the generated template contributes its items to that section. Any other section is appended. Additive only, nothing is ever removed.
_readme.rule: Every model entry carries a _source note saying how its values were confirmed.
_readme.note: Keys starting with an underscore are documentation and are skipped when loading.

_source.method: Ranges below were mapped against the fan itself. It validates every command and answers an out-of-range value with error_code 500003, so each bound is the first value the hardware refused, not a guess. The fan was restored to its original state afterwards.
_source.mode-5-turbo: Confirmed working on real hardware by a user who added it by hand before this override existed. The vendor config ships only modes 1-4 for this model.
_source.oscmode: Accepts 0-4, refuses 5 and above. All confirmed by eye: 1 swings the head left-right (Horizontal) and the fan's own panel shows a matching tilt icon, 2 tilts it up-down (Vertical), 3 does both at once (3D), 4 stops it at a held position (Fixed, which is what fixedconf 50,35 describes). Setting any of them while the fan is off is accepted and then reverted to 0 by the firmware, since oscillation cannot engage on a stopped fan.
_source.atmon: Bool. Confirmed: the light ring came on and stayed on. Lives in the control stack rather than the preferences, because the colour and brightness rows above it are meaningless while it is off.
_source.atmmode: Accepts 1-3, refuses 4. All three confirmed by eye against the hardware: 1 holds a steady colour (Solid), 2 loops smoothly through hues, yellow to red and back (Flow), 3 fades one colour in and out (Breath). Note the vendor's own Breath string is number 3, not 1: guessing the order got it wrong, watching the ring got it right.
_source.atmspeed: Accepts 1-3, refuses 4 and above. An earlier reading of 1-9 was wrong: it came from a probe batch whose detection window caught a neighbouring command's reply, so 9 looked accepted when it is not. Re-mapped one value at a time against the fan. Three steps also matches atmbri and atmmode, which is the shape this light actually has.
_source.atmcolor: Packed 24-bit RGB. Accepts 0 through 16777215 and refuses 16777216, so the whole range is settable. The ten swatches are a chosen palette, not a device limit: any value in that range works.
_source.lightmode: Accepts 0-2, refuses 3, so it is a three-way display setting rather than the plain toggle the vendor config declares for the sibling HPF007S. Confirmed by eye: 0 lets the panel go dark on its own (Auto Off), 1 keeps it lit showing wifi, speed and oscillation icons (On). 2 is the remaining state and Adaptive is the vendor's own wording for it.
_source.power: Uses fanon, not poweron. Sending poweron is refused with 500003.
